title: [auto-fix] Restore correct hexadecimal digit conversion
description:
The regression changes the offset for alphabetic hex digits from 9 to 8. That maps A-F and a-f one lower than their hexadecimal values, causing the reported escape decoding failures. Restoring the offset fixes the conversion while preserving the existing CUnescape behavior.

Reproduced failing tests:
- `CEscape.EscapeAndUnescape`
- `Unescape.BasicFunction`
- `CUnescapeTest.UnescapesMultipleHexNulls`
